content.text:
I don't have a record of Mira taking her first steps specifically. What I can see in her milestone history is "pulled to standing at the couch" (logged June 1) and "stacked three blocks" (logged May 1) — but nothing noting independent walking yet.

If she has started walking since then, it's worth telling me so I can log it. Otherwise, pulling to stand is often the stage right before first steps, so it may just be around the corner.
